_note: Exhibition layout content. Room geometry lives in lib/gallery/architecture.ts; this file assigns works to rooms and walls. Wall: L/R = side walls (t = 0..1 from room entrance to far end), B = far partition (x = metres from centre), F = feature wall.

exhibition.title: MINDED: First Rooms
exhibition.subtitle: A virtual exhibition in six spaces
exhibition.statement: MINDED explores the relationship between intention and accident. The practice embraces experimentation, unexpected outcomes, material intervention and the discovery of meaning through creative play.

rooms.title: Entrance Hall
rooms.subtitle: MINDED
rooms.intro: Titanium white, deep green and a short statement of intent. The rooms beyond continue in sequence.

rooms.title: Photography & Solitude
rooms.subtitle: LONELY
rooms.intro: Calm, distance and contemplation. A single photograph moved onto an unexpected support.

rooms.title: Colour Studies
rooms.subtitle: SHADES OF
rooms.intro: Six concentric colour studies, hung together so the relationships between them can be compared.

rooms.title: Interventions
rooms.subtitle: JUSTICE · BLACK & GOLD
rooms.intro: Photographs and surfaces altered by hand. Visualisations are labelled as such; nothing in this room is presented as finished unless stated.

rooms.title: AURA
rooms.subtitle: AURA 001
rooms.intro: A dedicated room for AURA 001. The object here is a web SIMULATION of its two states, not the physical installation.

rooms.title: The Archive
rooms.subtitle: Process, studies, accidents
rooms.intro: An evolving room for sketches, process material and future studies.
